purpose: Prevent platform migration from silently dropping critical information, capability, history, or state.
promotion_policy: NEVER promote a new platform merely because it launches or looks correct.
predecessor_policy: Preserve the old platform unchanged until parity and rollback are verified.
truth_policy: Missing data must be labeled MISSING or NOT_MIGRATED, never treated as empty.
Referenced-only features must not be presented as installed or runtime-tested.
Device/network-bound features remain explicitly labeled until tested on the target device.
No fabricated physical tests, measurements, prototypes, approvals, or manufacturing proof.
critical_domains: Universal Files / imports / exports / exact-byte originals
Production jobs / travelers / revisions / lots / tests / failures
Games library / manifests / user-owned ROM references / saves / save states
Garden Immortals / First Light source lineage / saves / autonomy-rest policy
Material Canon / Physics Vault / Constraint Graph
Failure Taxonomy / Lifecycle Registry / Provenance Index
App settings / route state / permissions state where exportable
Backups / rollback packages / release manifests / SHA-256 evidence
promotion_gates: Freeze source platform and record version/build identity.
Generate file/data counts and SHA-256 evidence before migration.
Export all portable state without deleting originals.
Compare project counts, file counts, log counts, saves, production records and critical database rows.
Verify exact-byte hashes for migrated files where possible.
Verify Cantus/audit history continuity and append-only ordering.
Verify all 144 routes exist and render without missing-mount errors.
Verify Files, Library, Games, Garden, Production, Logs, Projects, Auto Finish and Farm Time on the physical device.
Verify Android file opening/import/export/share/print and permissions.
Verify game runtime handoff and save persistence.
Verify Garden current playable branch and saves.
Verify backup and restore on disposable test data.
Verify rollback to the predecessor platform.
Only then mark the target platform PROMOTED.

failure_behavior.on_missing_component: Show the component and mark it NOT_MIGRATED or MISSING with its last known source/evidence.
failure_behavior.on_count_mismatch: Block promotion and produce a reconciliation report.
failure_behavior.on_hash_mismatch: Block promotion and preserve both copies.
failure_behavior.on_runtime_failure: Keep predecessor available; do not silently disable or remove the feature.
failure_behavior.on_unknown: Preserve evidence and mark UNKNOWN/REVIEW rather than guessing.
